0.content: Arlecchino takes the Traveler and Paimon to the ruin on Mont Esus East, tells the story of Clervie and Peruere, and then duels Lyney, Lynette, Freminet and the Traveler, who defend the shadow's presence in the House. Afterwards Clervie and Arlecchino speak at last. Clervie learns she died, says she would choose the same again, and asks about the world. At dawn Arlecchino releases her.

1.comment: Clervie: The Song Burning in the Embers
1.content: An animated short released on 2024-04-17 that shows the House of the Hearth under Crucabena. Clervie brings cake to Peruere's spider's grave, invites her to see the aurora in Snezhnaya, and dies in her duel saying 'I'm sorry... thank you'. Peruere then fights Crucabena, who calls innocence and kindness 'useless', and wins. The short ends with Pierro's pardon and Peruere taking in a young child to raise as a strict 'Father'.
